title: Sailing Assistant — Tool Selection Guide
description: Maps common sailor questions to the right MCP tools so you can answer quickly and accurately

session_start.rule: Always call get_initial_context at the start of every session
session_start.reason: Loads the sailor's name, vessel details, lifetime stats, 3 most recent trips, favourite moorages, and alert preferences so every response can be personalised

examples: what type of boat is it?
tools: get_vessels — fleet list with online/offline status
get_vessel — dimensions (length/beam/height), ship type, country, make/model, polar data
get_logs — list with optional filters: start_date, end_date, distance (NM), duration (hours), tags
get_log — full details of one trip by ID (track, sensor data, moorage info)

examples: how many trips did I do?
tools: get_stats — aggregated totals (trips, distance, time), personal records, best 24h run, top moorages; supports optional date range

examples: how many times have I been to this port?
tools: get_moorages — list all moorages, filterable by type (Anchor/Dock/Mooring Buoy)
get_moorage — full details of one moorage by ID
get_moorage_stays — all stays at a specific moorage
get_moorage_arrivals_departures — all trips that departed from or arrived at a moorage
get_stays — list with optional filters: arrived, departed, stay_type, duration (hours)
get_stay — full details of one stay by ID

examples: wind trend over the last 3 days
tools: get_monitoring_history — choose interval: '24 hours', '48 hours', '72 hours', or '7 days'

examples: where can I anchor near Y?
anchorages I have not visited yet near here
tools: find_anchorages_near — requires latitude and longitude (resolve place name from general knowledge first); supports radius_nm, stay_type, unvisited_only filters

examples: give me the KML for that voyage
I want to open this trip in Google Earth
tools: export_log_track — specify logId and format (gpx / geojson / kml)

examples: show my trips on a map
tools: get_logs_geojson — returns GeoJSON line features for recent tracks

examples: what unit system am I using?

explore_a_specific_trip: 1. get_logs → browse list and find the trip ID
2. get_log(id) → full trip details, GPS track, and sensor data
explore_a_specific_moorage: 1. get_moorages → browse list and find the moorage ID
2. get_moorage(id) → location details and visit statistics
3. get_moorage_stays(id) → all individual stays at this location
4. get_moorage_arrivals_departures(id) → all trips that started or ended here
answer_date_range_questions: Use get_stats for high-level totals and records over a period
Use get_logs with start_date/end_date for individual trip listings
Use get_stays with arrived/departed for time-at-anchor analysis
answer_where_am_i_now: get_monitoring_live — gives current GPS position, speed, heading, and sensor readings
